sourceNote: Curated from implementation review of the current DFP-NEO codebase. This layer supplements, but does not replace, the generated source audit.

functions.name: Open the DFP schedule
functions.purpose: Opens the main DFP timeline used to view, build and edit the daily schedule.
procedureSteps: Click DFP on the left sidebar.
Use the location/unit selector if you need a different unit.
Use the date control to select the day.
Use the top and right-side controls for schedule actions such as validation, NEO Build and publish.
outputs: Displays the selected day's DFP timeline and schedule controls.
dependencies: A configured unit/location is required for a fully populated operational schedule.
businessRules: If the customer baseline has not been configured, the DFP page may show the initial setup required prompt instead of operational schedule data.
failureConditions: The button can be unavailable when the logged-in user lacks the DFP view permission.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Initial Setup Wizard
functions.purpose: Guides first-time customer configuration before the first operational DFP is built.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
On a blank customer baseline, use the Initial Setup Wizard prompt.
Enter the organisation, location, unit, aircraft/resources and training setup data.
Work through the mandatory setup steps before attempting the first operational build.

validation: Organisation hierarchy and location data are required before normal scheduling can be meaningful.
inputs.sourceOfData: Initial setup wizard draft and platform configuration

validation: Expected to be a location identifier used by the configured unit/location context.
dependencies: Location configuration

outputs: Creates or updates organisation, location, unit and setup configuration used by the rest of the application.
dependencies: Platform configuration must be writeable by the logged-in user.
businessRules: The DFP page keeps the setup prompt visible until required location/unit configuration exists.
failureConditions: Live synchronisation of settings can change the active location while the wizard is open if the workflow does not preserve the in-progress wizard state.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Trainee unavailability
functions.purpose: Records when a trainee is not available for scheduling.
procedureSteps: Open Trainee.
Open the trainee's profile.
Open the Unavailable tab.
Click Add Unavailability.
Enter the date/time period and reason.
Save the unavailability record.

dependencies: Trainee roster

validation: Start and end must define the period to block.

outputs: Updates trainee availability data used by schedule views and build eligibility checks.
dependencies: The trainee must exist in the active unit/course context.
businessRules: Unavailable periods can prevent allocation when the event overlaps the recorded period.
failureConditions: The trainee may still appear in historical records even if unavailable for new scheduling.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Staff unavailability
functions.purpose: Records when a staff member or instructor is not available for scheduling.
procedureSteps: Open Staff.
Open the staff member's profile.
Open the Unavailable tab.
Click Add Unavailability.
Enter the date/time period and reason.
Save the unavailability record.
outputs: Updates staff availability data used by schedule views, duty pilot personnel summaries and build eligibility checks.
dependencies: The staff member must exist in the active unit context.
businessRules: Unavailable staff should not be selected for conflicting scheduled events.
failureConditions: A staff member counted in a personnel category may not be available for scheduling if a leave or pause status applies.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Delete staff member
functions.purpose: Deletes a staff/personnel record from the staff database.
procedureSteps: Open Staff.
Open the staff database or staff management table.
Find the staff member.
Use Delete on that staff row.
Confirm the delete prompt.
outputs: Calls the personnel delete endpoint and removes the staff record from the database table.
dependencies: The logged-in user must have admin-level access to the staff database controls.
businessRules: Deleting a staff member is different from making them unavailable. Use unavailability when the person is temporarily unable to fly; use delete only when the staff/personnel record should be removed.
failureConditions: Delete can fail if the user lacks permission, the personnel record no longer exists, or the backend refuses the personnel delete request.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Delete or Archive Trainee
functions.purpose: Archives or permanently deletes a trainee from the Trainee Roster workflow. Archive is the recommended option because it hides the trainee from the active roster while preserving the record for later restoration.
procedureSteps: Open Trainee.
Stay on Trainee Profile / Trainee Roster.
Use the trainee removal/delete action to open Delete or Archive Trainee.
Select the course.
Select the trainee.
Choose Archive Trainee (Recommended) to hide the trainee from the active roster while keeping the record, or choose Delete Permanently only when permanent removal is required.
Enter your password.
Click Archive Trainee or Delete Trainee.

validation: A course must be selected before a trainee can be selected.
dependencies: Active trainee courses

validation: A trainee in the selected course must be selected.
dependencies: Selected course

validation: Password is required to confirm archive/delete action.

outputs: Archives the trainee for active roster purposes or permanently deletes the trainee record, depending on the selected action.
dependencies: The selected course and trainee must exist in the active roster data.
businessRules: Archive Trainee is recommended because it hides the trainee from the active roster but keeps all data and can be restored later. Delete Permanently removes the trainee from the database and cannot be undone.
failureConditions: The action is disabled until course, trainee and password are entered. Permanent delete should only be used when approved and not when record retention is required.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from DeleteTraineeConfirmation.tsx

functions.name: Trainee roster
functions.purpose: Displays trainees grouped by active course and provides course-level trainee management actions.
procedureSteps: Open Trainee.
Stay on Trainee Profile / Trainee Roster.
Use Add Trainee to create a trainee manually.
Use Upload to import trainees.
Use Active Courses to manage which course cards are shown.
outputs: Displays active course cards, assigned trainees, status indicators and course edit controls.
dependencies: Active courses and trainee records must exist for populated course cards.
businessRules: Archived courses should not be shown as active roster cards.
failureConditions: Courses with no active trainees can appear empty; they should be archived rather than permanently deleted when retention matters.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Primary and Secondary Instructor
functions.purpose: Records the normal instructor relationships used for trainee management and scheduling eligibility.
procedureSteps: Open Trainee.
Open the trainee's profile.
Find the instructor assignment area.
Select the Primary Instructor or Secondary Instructor from the available staff list.
Save the trainee profile changes.
outputs: Updates the trainee's primaryInstructor and secondaryInstructor values.
dependencies: The instructor must exist as staff in the relevant unit/context and be available in the selector.
businessRules: NEO Build can prefer or require the Primary Instructor depending on priority/build settings, with Secondary Instructor used only where the configured rules allow it.
failureConditions: An instructor may be unavailable for selection if they are outside the unit/context, not configured as staff, not visible under the current Master LMP/unit access, or excluded by scheduling rules.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Course management
functions.purpose: Manages active and archived course records, including course names, dates, colours and grouping labels.
procedureSteps: Open Training Records.
Select Courses Management.
Use Add Course for a new course.
Use Edit on a course tile to change course details.
Use Archived Courses to view archived course records.
outputs: Creates or updates course records used by Trainee Roster, Course Progress and training record views.
dependencies: Course data must sync with trainee/course progress data for dates and counts to endure refreshes.
businessRules: Course labels used for group counts should come from configured trainee service values where implemented.
failureConditions: If dates are edited only in local UI state and not persisted, they will revert after refresh.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Archive course
functions.purpose: Removes a course from active operational views while preserving the course record for future reference.
procedureSteps: Open Training Records.
Select Courses Management.
Find the course tile.
Use the archive action rather than permanent delete when training history may need to be retained.
Use Archived Courses to view or reference archived courses later.
outputs: Moves a course between active and archived course views, depending on the selected action.
dependencies: Course records and linked trainee/training results must be retained when archival is required.
businessRules: Permanent deletion is treated as a higher-risk administrative action than archiving and should require stronger warning/confirmation.
failureConditions: Permanent delete can remove records that may be needed for legal, regulatory or training history reasons.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Course Progress
functions.purpose: Displays trainee progress, course-level progress cards, risk indicators, scores and ranking outputs.
procedureSteps: Open Course Progress.
Review the course progress tiles at the top.
Scroll to Course Scores & Rankings for saved training report scores and award rankings.
Use Risk Settings if the risk thresholds need adjustment.
Use Show Progress Graph on a course tile for detailed progress.
outputs: Displays progress metrics calculated from trainee/course/training report data.
dependencies: Active courses, trainee allocations and saved training report grades are required for populated results.
businessRules: Ranking outputs depend on selected course, selected award criteria, eligible trainees and saved grades for included events.
failureConditions: No scores are shown when there are no saved TRG REP overall grades matching the selected course and award criteria.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Training report
functions.purpose: Records training outcomes and grades for events and can trigger notification workflows when configured.
procedureSteps: Open Training Records.
Open the relevant trainee or event training record.
Enter the training report grades and comments.
Use the notification options if configured.
Save the training report so the grades feed Course Progress and Build Intelligence.
outputs: Creates or updates training report records and grade-derived analytics used by Course Progress and Build Intelligence.
dependencies: Configured training report templates, courses, events and trainees.
businessRules: Auto notifications depend on configured recipient roles and course-level staff assignments.
failureConditions: Scores and rankings remain empty when reports do not include saved overall grades for the selected criteria.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Training auto notifications
functions.purpose: Sends configured notification messages when training report conditions such as an unsatisfactory grade are met.
procedureSteps: Open Training Records.
Open the relevant training report workflow.
Enable the notification option for the report or condition.
Ensure the selected course has the relevant Course Commander or Deputy Course Commander assigned.
Check My Home messages for the delivered alert from DFP-NEO Alerts.
outputs: Creates in-app message records with the sender label DFP-NEO Alerts where implemented.
dependencies: Auto notification settings, recipient role selections and course commander/deputy course commander assignments.
businessRules: Recipients are derived from configured notification roles and matching course-level staff assignments.
failureConditions: No recipient is available if the relevant course commander/deputy field is blank or the notification role is not enabled.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: My Home messages
functions.purpose: Shows in-app conversations, received alerts, sent messages and message groups for the logged-in user.
procedureSteps: Open My Home.
Open Messages.
Use Inbox to read received conversations.
Use Compose to start or continue a conversation.
Use Groups if you need to create or use a saved recipient group.
outputs: Displays and sends dashboard message records through the DFP-NEO message APIs and local cache.
dependencies: The logged-in user must be identifiable as a message participant and the message API must be reachable.
businessRules: Messages are scoped to the logged-in user and the contacts/groups available to that user.
failureConditions: Messages can appear to change or disappear if the local cache and server-backed message state are refreshed and the message is not addressed to the logged-in user.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Build Intelligence risk events
functions.purpose: Explains event-level risk outputs in Build Intelligence managerial analytics.
procedureSteps: Open Build Intelligence.
Open the managerial analytics tab.
Review Event Difficulty Ranking for average grade and attempt count.
Review Elevated Risk Events for events where the below-pass percentage crosses the elevated-risk threshold.
Review Low Risk Events for events that meet the high-performance threshold and minimum data requirements.
outputs: Displays event difficulty ranking, elevated risk events, low risk events and course analysis narrative.
dependencies: Saved training report grades, enough attempts for the event, configured risk thresholds and selected course/context.
businessRules: Elevated risk is not simply the lowest average score; it can depend on the proportion of attempts below pass grade. Low risk requires sufficiently strong grades, low variance and enough attempts.
failureConditions: Low Risk Events can be empty when no event meets the high-grade, low-variance and minimum-attempt criteria.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: NEO Build
functions.purpose: Runs the automated scheduling/build process for the DFP.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Select the date and unit you want to build.
Click NEO Build on the right sidebar.
Review the generated schedule tiles.
Run Validation Check before publishing.
outputs: Creates or updates schedule tiles according to build rules, priorities, resources and availability data.
dependencies: Courses, trainees, staff, resources, aircraft/simulator availability, build rules, priorities and duty/turnaround configuration.
businessRules: Build eligibility is affected by availability, qualifications, currencies, resource availability, priorities, conflicts, duty constraints and progression data.
failureConditions: A person or event may not be scheduled when any required dependency or eligibility condition is not satisfied.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Build priorities
functions.purpose: Configures scheduling priority inputs used by NEO Build.
procedureSteps: Open Priorities from the right sidebar.
Review the course, package and event priorities.
Adjust priorities for the build objective.
Return to DFP and run NEO Build.
Remember that priorities influence order but do not override hard constraints.
outputs: Updates priority settings that influence future schedule generation.
dependencies: Active courses, events/packages and configured build rules.
businessRules: Priority settings influence ordering but do not override hard eligibility constraints such as availability or resource conflicts.
failureConditions: A high-priority event can still remain unscheduled when mandatory resources, people or rules are not satisfied.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Validation Check
functions.purpose: Shows schedule validation warnings and conflict indicators for the current DFP.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Select the date and unit to check.
Click Validation Check in the top toolbar.
Review any warning or conflict indicators.
Fix the schedule or settings that caused the warning, then run validation again.
outputs: Displays validation state for schedule tiles and conflicts.
dependencies: Current schedule tile data and validation rules.
businessRules: Validation identifies issues but does not automatically fix the DFP.
failureConditions: The action can be unavailable when the current user lacks validation permission in the active configuration.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Multi Select
functions.purpose: Turns on DFP tile multi-selection so more than one schedule tile can be selected at the same time.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Click Multi Select in the top toolbar.
Click schedule tiles to add or remove them from the selection, or drag a selection box across tiles on the timeline.
Use the available bulk action for the selected tiles.
Click Multi Select again to turn the mode off.
outputs: Tracks the selected schedule tile IDs while Multi Select mode is active.
dependencies: The current permission profile must allow Multi Select, or the user must otherwise have edit access to DFP tiles.
businessRules: Multi Select changes selection mode; it does not by itself edit, move or delete tiles.
failureConditions: The Multi Select button is disabled when the logged-in user does not have the required permission for the active DFP context.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Flight details
functions.purpose: Displays and edits details for a selected flight or simulator tile.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Click the flight or simulator tile.
Use the details window to review timing, syllabus item and crew/personnel.
Use the personnel dropdowns to change Instructor/Trainee or PIC/Crew as applicable.
Save the tile changes.
outputs: Updates scheduled event details such as crew/personnel, timing, event/syllabus item and related tile data.
dependencies: A selected schedule tile and relevant person/event/resource lists.
businessRules: Flight-school labels may use Instructor/Trainee; air-combat model labels may use PIC/Crew where configured.
failureConditions: Dropdown options may be limited by the active unit, course, model, personnel eligibility and resource context.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Aircraft availability
functions.purpose: Records or reviews aircraft availability for the DFP and scheduling workflow.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Select the relevant date and unit.
Click Aircraft Available in the top toolbar.
Review or change the aircraft availability state.
Run Validation Check or NEO Build again if availability changes affect the schedule.
outputs: Updates aircraft availability information used by DFP display, validation and build eligibility.
dependencies: Configured aircraft/resource rows for the active unit.
businessRules: Unavailable aircraft should not be used for conflicting schedule allocations.
failureConditions: The control may be hidden or unavailable when the active operational model or permission set does not expose aircraft availability editing.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Add flight tile
functions.purpose: Creates a manual flight or simulator tile on the DFP timeline.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Select the relevant date and unit.
Click Add Flight Tile in the top toolbar.
Enter the timing, resource, syllabus item and personnel details.
Save the tile, then run Validation Check.
outputs: Creates or updates a scheduled event tile on the DFP timeline.
dependencies: A valid schedule date, resource row and available personnel/event options.
businessRules: Manual tiles still need to satisfy validation rules such as timing, conflicts and required fields.
failureConditions: Dropdowns may be empty if resources, courses, staff or trainees are not configured for the active unit.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Publish DFP
functions.purpose: Publishes the current DFP schedule so it becomes the live operational schedule.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Select the date and unit to publish.
Run Validation Check and review warnings.
Click Publish on the right sidebar.
Confirm the publish action if prompted.
outputs: Marks or stores the current DFP state as published/live for operational use.
dependencies: A built or manually prepared DFP for the selected date/unit.
businessRules: Publishing should normally occur after validation and review.
failureConditions: Publish may be unavailable if the user lacks publish permission or no current schedule is ready to publish.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Turnaround settings
functions.purpose: Configures turnaround timing rules used by scheduling and validation.
procedureSteps: Open Settings.
Open the relevant business/build rule area.
Find the turnaround setting for the resource type.
Enter the required turnaround time.
Save the settings before running NEO Build or Validation Check again.
outputs: Updates build/validation timing assumptions for aircraft, simulator and trainer turnaround where configured.
dependencies: Active organisation/unit build rule settings.
businessRules: Turnaround rules can prevent back-to-back allocations that do not leave the required separation.
failureConditions: Changes affect future build and validation logic, not necessarily already-published historical schedules.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Flight authorisation warning settings
functions.purpose: Controls whether flight authorisation is required and when unsigned current-day flight tiles show warning colours.
procedureSteps: Open Settings.
Open the DFP Build Rules or equivalent build-rule settings area.
Find Flight tile authorisation warnings.
Set Flight authorisation required.
Set the amber warning and red urgent minutes before start.
Save the settings.
outputs: Updates tile status settings used by flight tiles, Duty Pilot AUTH and current-day authorisation warning colours.
dependencies: The active unit/build-rule settings must be editable by the logged-in user.
businessRules: When flight authorisation is optional, authorisation warning colours and controls are disabled or treated as optional for that unit.
failureConditions: Changes affect current/future warning behaviour but do not by themselves sign any flight authorisation.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Service and course group labels
functions.purpose: Defines service/group labels used by trainee profiles and course grouping/count displays.
procedureSteps: Open Settings.
Open the organisation or people configuration area.
Edit the service/group labels.
Use labels that match the Service values used in trainee profiles.
Save the settings so course group counts can use the configured labels.
outputs: Provides configured service options for trainee profile service values and course group labels.
dependencies: Organisation settings and trainee profile service fields.
businessRules: Course group counts are meaningful only when course group labels align with trainee service values.
failureConditions: Legacy or hardcoded values can remain in records until staff and trainee data are migrated to configured labels.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Duty Pilot personnel management
functions.purpose: Shows duty-pilot operational personnel summaries and counts.
procedureSteps: Open Duty Pilot.
Find Personnel Management.
Hover over On Leave, TMUF or Other Unavailability counts to see the people included.
Open the person's staff or trainee profile if the underlying status needs to be changed.
outputs: Displays personnel category counts and hover details for affected people where implemented.
dependencies: Staff/personnel status and availability data.
businessRules: Paused status and leave/unavailability categories should remain distinct in the displayed lists.
failureConditions: Counts can be misleading if the hover list mixes people from a different personnel category.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Course leadership assignments
functions.purpose: Assigns the staff members who hold course-level leadership roles for a course.
procedureSteps: Open Trainee.
Stay on Trainee Profile / Trainee Roster.
Find the course card.
Click the pencil/edit button on that course card.
Use Course Leadership to select the Course Commander or Deputy Course Commander.
Save the course changes.

permittedValues: Staff members from the relevant individual unit options shown in the edit course flyout.
validation: Must be selected from available staff options when assigned.
dependencies: Staff records
active course
unit context

permittedValues: Staff members from the relevant individual unit options shown in the edit course flyout.
validation: Must be selected from available staff options when assigned.
dependencies: Staff records
active course
unit context

outputs: Updates the selected course's course commander and deputy course commander values.
dependencies: Course leadership must be enabled and staff records must exist for the relevant unit.
businessRules: Training auto-notification recipients can be derived from these course-level assignments when the matching recipient role is enabled.
failureConditions: Messages cannot be sent to a course commander or deputy course commander if the course field is blank, not persisted, or the role is not enabled in notification settings.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Course Scores table
functions.purpose: Displays saved training-report overall grades by trainee and event for the selected course.
procedureSteps: Open Course Progress.
Scroll to Course Scores & Rankings.
Use the Course selector in Course Scores.
Check that the selected course has trainees and saved training report overall grades.
Use Settings in Course Scores if the event types are being filtered out.

validation: Must match an active course with trainees and saved report scores.
dependencies: active courses
trainee assignments
saved training report grades

outputs: Displays event columns and trainee score cells for saved overall grades.
dependencies: Training reports must have saved overall grades for events included by the Course Scores settings.
businessRules: Only events with saved training report overall grades matching the selected course and event-type filters are shown.
failureConditions: The table can appear empty when no trainees, no saved overall grades, or filtered-out event types match the selected course.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Course ranking awards
functions.purpose: Creates and evaluates named ranking awards against selected course/event criteria.
procedureSteps: Open Course Progress.
Scroll to Course Scores & Rankings.
Use the Course selector in Course Rankings.
Select the Award.
If no ranking appears, check that the award includes events with saved scores for the selected course.

validation: The selected award must be evaluated against the currently selected course.
dependencies: active courses
award criteria
saved training report grades

permittedValues: Configured awards for the active setup
validation: Award criteria must include events and a scoring method.
dependencies: course ranking settings

outputs: Displays ranked trainees, average score and score count where matching data exists.
dependencies: Saved overall grades for the selected award events and course trainees.
businessRules: The selected course must be applied when evaluating a ranking award; rankings should not reuse another course's previous selection.
failureConditions: No ranking data is available when award criteria do not match saved scores for the selected course.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Master LMP Access
functions.purpose: Defines which locations and units can view, assign or manage each Master LMP record.
procedureSteps: Open Settings.
Open Deployment & Security.
Open Master LMP Access.
Add or edit the Master LMP catalogue record first.
Add or edit the access rule for the required unit.
outputs: Updates Master LMP catalogue records and access rules used by trainee/course assignment workflows.
dependencies: Organisation, location and unit settings must exist for scoped access rules.
businessRules: Access levels are evaluated against the selected unit before Master LMPs can be assigned to courses or trainees.
failureConditions: A Master LMP may not appear for a user or unit when no matching access rule exists or its catalogue record is inactive.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Master LMP event details
functions.purpose: Displays and manages event-level detail for Master LMP content and related assignment workflows.
procedureSteps: Open Settings.
Open the Master LMP area.
Select the Master LMP.
Select the event from the event list.
Use the event detail panel next to the selected event.
outputs: Shows selected event details and supports editing where the user has manage access.
dependencies: A Master LMP catalogue record and event content must exist.
businessRules: Users should be able to see the selected event details near the event list rather than needing to scroll away from the selected event.
failureConditions: The edit action may be unavailable if the user lacks manage access for the Master LMP.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Duty Pilot flight tracking
functions.purpose: Displays the embedded flight tracking widget within the Duty Pilot page.
procedureSteps: Open Duty Pilot.
Go to Flight Tracking.
If the embedded view is blank, use the external link to confirm the tracking provider itself is reachable.
If the external link works but the embedded view does not, the provider or browser is probably blocking embedding.
outputs: Shows the configured tracking widget when the browser and remote tracking site allow embedding.
dependencies: The flight tracking provider must permit embedding in the deployed DFP-NEO page.
businessRules: If the provider blocks framing or embedding, the in-page widget can fail even when the external hyperlink opens successfully.
failureConditions: Browser frame restrictions, provider CSP/X-Frame-Options, VPN/network policy or mixed-content restrictions can prevent the embedded tracker from displaying.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review

functions.name: Flight authorisation
functions.purpose: Records AUTHO and PIC/captain authorisation for a flight before it proceeds.
procedureSteps: Open Duty Pilot.
Find the AUTH window.
Select the flight that requires authorisation, or click Go to Flight Authorisation.
Select the AUTHO and PIC/captain as required.
Use Sign for the required role and enter the authorised person's PIN.
Repeat until both AUTHO and PIC/captain signatures are recorded.

workflowOptions.name: Duty Pilot AUTH window
workflowOptions.summary: Use Duty Pilot when you want to work through flights requiring authorisation from the duty page.
procedureSteps: Open Duty Pilot.
Find the AUTH window.
Select the flight that requires authorisation, or click Go to Flight Authorisation.
Select the AUTHO and PIC/captain as required.
Use Sign for the required role and enter the authorised person's PIN.
Repeat until both AUTHO and PIC/captain signatures are recorded.

workflowOptions.name: DFP tile context menu
workflowOptions.summary: Use the DFP tile when you already know which scheduled flight needs authorisation.
procedureSteps: Open DFP.
Find the scheduled flight tile.
Open the tile context menu.
Select Flight Authorisation.
Select or confirm the AUTHO and PIC/captain.
Sign the required roles with the authorised person's PIN.

workflowOptions.name: Mobile app
workflowOptions.summary: Use the mobile app when the authorised person is completing the authorisation from the mobile workflow.
procedureSteps: Open the DFP-NEO mobile app.
Open the flight requiring authorisation.
Complete the AUTHO and PIC/captain authorisation steps in the app.
Sync back to DFP-NEO.
Confirm the completed authorisation appears against the flight in the DFP or Duty Pilot view.

outputs: Updates the flight tile with AUTHO and PIC/captain authorisation signatures, notes and timestamps.
dependencies: Flight authorisation must be enabled for the unit, the flight must still require authorisation, and authorised staff/PIN details must be available.
businessRules: A flight is fully authorised only when both AUTHO and PIC/captain signatures are recorded. Verbal AUTH can record a signer acting on behalf of the selected person.
failureConditions: The Auth controls are disabled when flight authorisation is optional for the unit, the DFP is locked, the emergency freeze blocks authorisation, or the required signer/PIN is not available.
functions.auditStatus: IMPLEMENTED - manually enriched from current implementation review
